taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-01, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-01, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-01, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model comprises four layers. Resistivity increases monotonically with depth: Layer 1 (1056.4 Ω·m, 0–23.97 m), Layer 2 (1090.4 Ω·m, 23.97–25.43 m), Layer 3 (2606.8 Ω·m, 25.43–28.60 m), and Layer 4 (3560.6 Ω·m, below 28.60 m, inferred as basement/high-resistivity substratum).

Applying the curve-type convention: for layers 1-2-3, r1 < r2 < r3 → A; for layers 2-3-4, r2 < r3 < r4 → A. This yields an AA sequence, which simplifies to a single A-type curve, consistent with a steadily increasing resistivity profile.

The file classification of HA-type does not match this resistivity progression, as an H-curve requires r1 > r2, which is not observed here. Recommend review of the on-file classification before finalizing the interpretation report.

{"curve_type_stated": "HA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
